chunks: A group informed me of it from Abū Muḥammad Hārūn ibn Mūsā, from Abū al-ʿAbbās Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Saʿīd, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl. And Aḥmad ibn ʿAbdūn also informed me from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn al-Zubayr, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Najrān, from Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā, from ʿĪṣ ibn al-Qāsim al-Bajalī, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a woman who menstruates in Ramadan before the sun sets. He said: “She breaks her fast.”

key_terms.امْرَأَةٍ: a woman, the subject of the legal ruling
key_terms.تَغِيبَ الشَّمْسُ: the sun sets; the completion time of the daily fast
key_terms.تُفْطِرُ: she breaks the fast; the ruling given by the Imam عليه السلام
key_terms.رَمَضَانَ: the month of fasting in which the ruling applies
key_terms.طَمِثَتْ: she menstruated; the onset of menses

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman begins menstruating just before sunset in Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning fasting in Ramadan when menstruation begins before sunset. It states that if a woman begins menstruating before the sun has set, her fast is no longer continued and she breaks it.
